description: This file is a localization (i18n) module for Select2 version 4.0.6-rc.1, providing Arabic translations for various interface messages such as error messages, input length warnings, loading indicators, and selection limits.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when there is an error loading results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should delete some input characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should add more input characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown while more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while a search is in progress.
